KN.investment_route: Donation to the SISC fund (250000 USD for main applicant or family of up to 4); Developer's real estate investment (325000 USD fractional ownership, or 600000 USD for full ownership, in an approved development, 7yr resale restriction); Approved public benefit project
KN.investment_breakdown: SISC: main applicant or family of up to 4 members at USD 250,000; each additional dependant under 18 adds USD 25,000; each additional dependant 18 or over adds USD 50,000; funds five priorities: local food production, green energy transition, economic diversification, sustainable industry, and social protection. Real estate: minimum USD 325,000 per main applicant for fractional ownership in an approved development, or from USD 600,000 for full ownership; resaleable after 7 years
KN.additional_fees: SISC route: due diligence fee of USD 10,000 for the main applicant plus USD 7,500 per dependant aged 16 or over. Real estate route: same due diligence fees, plus post-approval application fees of USD 25,000 (main applicant), USD 15,000 (spouse), USD 10,000 (dependant under 18), USD 15,000 (dependant 18+), plus compulsory insurance fund contributions and conveyance fees
KN.physical_presence_requirement: none required to obtain or maintain citizenship
KN.due_diligence: interview is mandatory for the main applicant, conducted virtually or in person by an independent firm commissioned by the CIU or by CIU officials; dependants aged 16 or over may also be required to attend an interview if deemed necessary; applications from citizens of Afghanistan, Belarus, Iran, Iraq, North Korea, and Russia are not accepted; biometric enrolment introduced 2026
KN.family_inclusion: Spouse; children under 18; children aged 18-30 in full-time secondary or tertiary education and fully supported by the main applicant; children 18+ who are physically or mentally challenged; parents of the main applicant or spouse aged 55+ living with and fully supported by the main applicant
KN.naturalization_timeline: citizenship is granted immediately on approval — no residency period, physical presence, or naturalization wait is required
KN.renewal_requirements: citizenship is granted for life; no residency requirement to maintain it; the passport itself is renewed periodically like any other passport
KN.eligibility_criteria: Main applicant must be 18+; must make or agree to make the legally prescribed investment; must pass due diligence checks and financial criteria; not eligible if previously denied citizenship of any country, denied a visa to a country St Kitts and Nevis citizens can enter visa-free (and not since obtained that visa), has a criminal record, is under criminal investigation, was declared bankrupt within the preceding 10 years, or is involved in activity likely to cause disrepute to St Kitts and Nevis
KN.key_benefits: Visa-free or visa-on-arrival access to 150+ destinations including the UK, Schengen Area, Hong Kong, and Singapore; No personal income, capital gains, wealth, or inheritance tax; Oldest continuously running CBI program in the world, established 1984
KN.taxation_notes: no tax on worldwide income, capital gains, gifts, or inheritance for citizens who are not otherwise tax-resident elsewhere
KN.application_steps: Select an Authorised Agent (applications cannot be submitted directly to the CIU); complete all forms and supply required documents through the Authorised Agent; attend an interview if required; the CIU processes the application and conducts due diligence, advising within 120-180 days whether it is approved-in-principle, denied, or delayed for cause; make the SISC contribution or complete the real estate purchase; receive the certificate of naturalisation and apply for a St Kitts and Nevis passport
KN.dual_citizenship: Fully permitted — no requirement to renounce any prior nationality

AG.investment_route: Donation to NDF; Real estate (300000 USD, 5yr hold, can be shared by 2 applicants); Business investment (1500000 USD single investor or 5000000 USD joint venture)
AG.investment_breakdown: 230000 USD covers a family of up to 4 under the NDF route; each additional dependant beyond 4 adds roughly 15000-25000 USD
AG.additional_fees: processing and due diligence fees separate from the core investment, typically several thousand USD per adult applicant
AG.physical_presence_requirement: 5 days physical presence required at some point within the first 5 years of citizenship
AG.due_diligence: standard international due diligence check; enhanced interview required for applicants flagged as higher-risk
AG.family_inclusion: Spouse; Children up to 30 (if dependent/in education); Parents and grandparents 55+; Unmarried siblings under 30
AG.naturalization_timeline: citizenship is granted immediately on approval; the 5-day stay requirement is the only presence obligation and can be fulfilled any time within 5 years
AG.renewal_requirements: citizenship is permanent; no renewal beyond standard passport reissuance
AG.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds; Good health
AG.key_benefits: Visa-free access to 150+ destinations including the UK, Schengen Area, and Hong Kong; One of the lower-cost options for a family of four; 5-day stay requirement is uniquely light compared to peer programs; note: a US Presidential Proclamation (10998, effective 1 January 2026) partially restricts US visas for Antiguan nationals — holders of valid US visas issued before that date are unaffected, but prospective travelers should check current US entry requirements
AG.taxation_notes: no tax on worldwide income, capital gains, or inheritance
AG.application_steps: select a licensed agent; submit application and required documents; undergo due diligence review; pay the NDF contribution or complete the real estate purchase; attend interview if requested; take the oath of allegiance within 5 years to finalize
AG.dual_citizenship: Fully permitted — no requirement to renounce any prior nationality

DM.investment_route: Donation to EDF; Real estate (200000 USD, 5yr hold, government-approved projects only)
DM.investment_breakdown: 200000 USD covers a single applicant; a family of 4 typically totals around 225000 USD under the EDF route
DM.additional_fees: government processing fees and due diligence fees apply per applicant in addition to the core contribution
DM.due_diligence: standard due diligence; Dominica was an early adopter of enhanced vetting after 2017 program reforms
DM.family_inclusion: Spouse; Children up to 30 (in full-time education); Parents/grandparents 65+; Unmarried/childless siblings 18-25
DM.naturalization_timeline: citizenship is granted immediately on approval — there is no residency period to serve
DM.renewal_requirements: citizenship is permanent; passport renewed every 10 years
DM.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds; Medical exam
DM.key_benefits: The lowest headline cost among Caribbean CBI programs; Visa-free access to 140+ destinations including the UK, Schengen Area, Hong Kong, and Singapore; note: a US Presidential Proclamation (10998, effective 1 January 2026) partially restricts US visas for Dominican nationals — holders of valid US visas issued before that date are unaffected, but prospective travelers should check current US entry requirements
DM.taxation_notes: no tax on worldwide income, capital gains, or inheritance
DM.application_steps: engage a licensed agent; submit forms, passport copies, and financial documents; due diligence review by the CBIU; make the donation or complete the real estate purchase; receive the certificate of registration and passport
DM.dual_citizenship: Fully permitted — no requirement to renounce any prior nationality

GD.investment_route: Donation to NTF (single applicant); Real estate (270000 USD, 5yr hold, shared eligible); Agricultural/other approved enterprise
GD.investment_breakdown: single applicant 235000 USD; family of 4 around 250000 USD under the NTF route; real estate route from 270000 USD per applicant, sometimes shared across co-investors
GD.additional_fees: government and due diligence processing fees apply per applicant on top of the core contribution
GD.due_diligence: standard due diligence, with additional scrutiny given Grenada's E-2 treaty relationship with the US
GD.family_inclusion: Spouse; Children up to 30 (dependent); Parents/grandparents of either spouse; Unmarried siblings up to 18
GD.naturalization_timeline: citizenship is granted immediately on approval; no separate residency period applies
GD.renewal_requirements: citizenship is permanent; passport renewed every 10 years
GD.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds
GD.key_benefits: The only Caribbean CBI program that gives access to the US E-2 Treaty Investor Visa (after roughly 3 years of citizenship, via Grenada's treaty with the US) without requiring US residency first; Visa-free access to 140+ destinations including China, the UK, and the Schengen Area
GD.taxation_notes: no tax on worldwide income, capital gains, or inheritance
GD.application_steps: engage a licensed agent; submit application and documents; due diligence review by the CBI Unit; make the qualifying investment; oath of allegiance and passport issuance
GD.dual_citizenship: Fully permitted — no requirement to renounce any prior nationality

LC.investment_route: Donation to NEF; Real estate (300000 USD, 5yr hold); Enterprise investment (3500000 USD single or 6000000 USD joint); Non-interest-bearing government bond (300000 USD, held 5 years)
LC.investment_breakdown: 240000 USD single applicant under NEF; family of 4 around 250000 USD; government bond route returns the full principal after the 5-year hold with no interest
LC.additional_fees: processing and due diligence fees per applicant apply in addition to the chosen investment route
LC.due_diligence: standard due diligence review by the CIP Unit
LC.family_inclusion: Spouse; Children up to 30 (dependent/in education); Parents/grandparents 55+ living with and dependent on the applicant; Unmarried siblings under 18
LC.naturalization_timeline: citizenship is granted immediately on approval; no residency period applies
LC.renewal_requirements: citizenship is permanent; passport renewed every 10 years
LC.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds
LC.key_benefits: The widest choice of investment routes among Caribbean CBI programs, including an interest-free government bond that returns full principal; Visa-free access to 140+ destinations
LC.taxation_notes: no tax on worldwide income, capital gains, or inheritance
LC.application_steps: engage a licensed agent; submit application; due diligence review; select and complete the chosen investment route; receive certificate of registration and passport
LC.dual_citizenship: Fully permitted — no requirement to renounce any prior nationality

TR.investment_route: Real estate (400000 USD, appraised value, 3yr resale restriction); Bank deposit (500000 USD, 3yr hold); Government bonds (500000 USD, 3yr hold); Job-creation investment (employing 50+ Turkish citizens)
TR.investment_breakdown: real estate value must be confirmed by an independent government-appointed appraiser; multiple properties can be combined to reach the threshold
TR.additional_fees: title deed registration fees, appraisal fees, and translation/notary costs are additional to the property price
TR.due_diligence: standard due diligence and title verification; appraisal report is a mandatory checkpoint
TR.naturalization_timeline: citizenship is granted directly upon approval, generally within a few months of completing the investment — no separate residency period
TR.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Investment value must be maintained/held for the required period
TR.key_benefits: One of the fastest large-economy citizenship options; Qualifying US investors may separately pursue the E-2 Treaty Investor Visa; Visa-free or visa-on-arrival access to 110+ destinations
TR.taxation_notes: worldwide income taxed only if tax-resident in Turkey (183+ days per year); non-resident citizens owe no Turkish tax on foreign-sourced income
TR.application_steps: select a qualifying investment (commonly real estate); obtain an official appraisal report confirming value; complete purchase/deposit and register with authorities; apply for a conformity certificate; submit citizenship application and biometrics
TR.dual_citizenship: Fully permitted — Turkey allows dual and multiple citizenship

VU.investment_route: Single, non-refundable donation to the state fund; Amount rises with each additional dependant
VU.investment_breakdown: 130000 USD for a single applicant; roughly 25000 USD per additional adult dependant and 15000 USD per minor child
VU.additional_fees: government processing fee and due diligence fee are included in published packages by most agents
VU.due_diligence: standard due diligence; Vanuatu's program has faced periodic scrutiny from the EU over visa-free Schengen access, leading to tightened vetting since 2022
VU.family_inclusion: Spouse; Dependent children under 18 (or up to 25/unmarried and in education); Dependent parents
VU.naturalization_timeline: citizenship is granted immediately on approval — no residency period
VU.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds
VU.key_benefits: The fastest CBI program in the world, often completing in 30-60 days; No personal income, capital gains, or inheritance tax; Visa-free access to 90+ destinations
VU.taxation_notes: no personal income tax, capital gains tax, or inheritance tax of any kind
VU.application_steps: engage a licensed agent; submit documents and application forms; due diligence review by the Vanuatu Citizenship Office; pay the contribution; receive the certificate and passport
VU.status: active, under periodic EU visa-suspension scrutiny
VU.dual_citizenship: Fully permitted — no requirement to renounce any prior nationality

EG.investment_route: Non-refundable donation to the state treasury (250000 USD); Real estate purchase (300000 USD, held 3+ years); Interest-free treasury deposit (500000 USD refunded after 5 years)
EG.investment_breakdown: the treasury deposit route returns the full principal after the hold period with no interest; the donation route is non-refundable
EG.additional_fees: administrative and legal fees apply on top of the investment amount
EG.processing_time: several months (varies by route and government processing capacity)
EG.due_diligence: standard security clearance through Egypt's Ministry of Interior in addition to financial due diligence
EG.naturalization_timeline: citizenship is granted directly by presidential/ministerial decree once security clearance and investment are confirmed — no residency wait
EG.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds
EG.key_benefits: Only North African sovereign CBI program; Provides a foothold for regional trade and business under Egypt's various trade agreements
EG.taxation_notes: worldwide income taxed only if tax-resident in Egypt; non-resident citizens are taxed on Egyptian-source income only
EG.application_steps: submit application with supporting documents through official channels; complete the chosen investment; undergo Ministry of Interior security clearance; receive citizenship decree
EG.dual_citizenship: Permitted for most applicants, though certain senior public-office and security-sensitive roles are restricted to those holding only Egyptian citizenship

JO.investment_route: Active investment in an approved commercial or industrial project in Amman, averaging JOD 700,000 in assets, employing at least 20 Jordanian nationals, and demonstrating 90% monthly compliance over 3 years; or the same structure outside Amman at a reduced JOD 350,000 threshold with at least 10 Jordanian employees; a retroactive route exists for investors who have already maintained JOD 350,000-700,000 in Jordan and created qualifying jobs over a sustained period
JO.investment_breakdown: the program was restructured in July 2025: the previous passive routes (a JOD 1,000,000 interest-free bank deposit or government bond, held 3-6 years) were phased out and replaced with active investment and job-creation requirements; existing legacy deposit or bond holders from before the restructuring should seek individual legal advice on their transition options
JO.additional_fees: administrative processing fees apply in addition to the core investment; Cabinet approval carries no separate formal fee beyond standard filing costs
JO.processing_time: several months, subject to Cabinet-level and royal approval
JO.due_diligence: standard financial due diligence plus a formal Cabinet review and Royal Decree requirement; job-creation and Social Security Corporation registration of employees must be verified as part of the active-investment routes
JO.naturalization_timeline: citizenship is granted directly once Cabinet and royal approval are obtained — no residency period
JO.renewal_requirements: citizenship is permanent, though naturalised citizens are barred from holding senior public office for 10 years
JO.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds
JO.key_benefits: access to Jordan's business environment at the crossroads of the Levant and Gulf, and to free-trade arrangements including Qualifying Industrial Zone access to US markets
JO.taxation_notes: worldwide income taxed only if tax-resident in Jordan
JO.application_steps: apply through the Jordan Investment Commission; select the deposit or enterprise route; complete financial and security due diligence; obtain Cabinet approval and Royal Decree; receive citizenship
JO.dual_citizenship: Generally permitted in practice under the 1954 Nationality Law as amended in 1987, and dual nationals are not automatically stripped of Jordanian citizenship; citizens are formally required to notify the government of any foreign nationality held, and acquisition of the nationality of a non-Arab state can in some circumstances require Cabinet consent — investors should seek case-specific legal advice

NR.program_name: Economic and Climate Resilience Citizenship Program
NR.investment_route: single non-refundable donation to Nauru's Treasury Fund, earmarked for climate resilience and relocation infrastructure
NR.investment_breakdown: 105000 USD for a single applicant; family packages typically scale to around 150000-170000 USD for a family of 4
NR.additional_fees: government processing and due diligence fees are usually bundled into published agent packages
NR.due_diligence: standard due diligence managed by the Nauru Program Office, launched with international advisory support in 2024
NR.family_inclusion: Spouse; Children; Parents; Grandparents; Siblings of the main applicant
NR.naturalization_timeline: citizenship is granted immediately on approval — no residency period
NR.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds
NR.key_benefits: Funds go directly toward Nauru's climate adaptation and relocation infrastructure; Visa-free or visa-on-arrival access including Hong Kong, Singapore, and the UAE
NR.taxation_notes: no personal income tax, capital gains tax, or inheritance tax
NR.application_steps: engage a licensed agent; submit documents; due diligence review by the Nauru Program Office; make the Treasury Fund contribution; receive certificate and passport
NR.dual_citizenship: Permitted — no requirement to renounce any prior nationality

ST.investment_route: single non-refundable donation to the National Transformation Fund
ST.investment_breakdown: 90000 USD for a single applicant; family of 4 typically around 130000-150000 USD
ST.additional_fees: processing and due diligence fees typically included in published agent packages
ST.due_diligence: standard due diligence; program launched 2025 with fully remote processing
ST.family_inclusion: Spouse; Children; Parents; Grandparents of the main applicant
ST.naturalization_timeline: citizenship is granted immediately on approval — no residency period
ST.renewal_requirements: citizenship is permanent, including a national ID card issued alongside the passport
ST.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds; Open to applicants of most nationalities
ST.key_benefits: The lowest headline cost of any sovereign CBI program; Fully remote application with no interview or physical presence requirement at any stage
ST.taxation_notes: no personal income tax, capital gains tax, or inheritance tax
ST.application_steps: engage a licensed agent; submit documents remotely; due diligence review by the CIU; make the donation; receive certificate, passport, and national ID
ST.dual_citizenship: Permitted — no requirement to renounce any prior nationality

PT.program_name: Golden Visa (ARI — Autorizacao de Residencia para Investimento)
PT.investment_route: Cultural heritage donation (250000 EUR, or 200000 EUR in low-density areas); Capital transfer into a qualifying investment/venture capital fund (500000 EUR); Job creation (10+ jobs); Direct residential real estate purchase was removed from the program in 2023
PT.investment_breakdown: fund route requires the fund itself to be regulated by the CMVM and not directly or indirectly hold residential real estate; donation route is the lowest-cost entry point
PT.additional_fees: NIF (tax number) registration, legal fees, and AIMA administrative/biometric fees are separate from the core investment, typically several thousand EUR total
PT.processing_time: 12-36 months (application backlog has historically extended timelines beyond official targets)
PT.physical_presence_requirement: 7 days in Portugal in year 1, then 14 days in each subsequent 2-year period — one of the lowest physical presence requirements of any EU golden visa
PT.due_diligence: standard due diligence through AIMA (Portugal's immigration agency, formerly SEF)
PT.family_inclusion: Spouse or partner; Dependent children; Dependent parents of either spouse
PT.naturalization_timeline: Portugal's Nationality Law was amended by Decree 48/XVII, signed 3 May 2026 and in force from 19 May 2026: the general naturalization period was extended from 5 years to 10 years of legal residence for most applicants, and to 7 years for nationals of EU and CPLP (Portuguese-speaking) countries; the residence clock now runs from the date the first residence card is issued rather than the application date; a new A2-level Portuguese language test, a civic/historical knowledge test, and a formal declaration of commitment to democratic principles are also required; citizenship applications formally submitted before 19 May 2026 continue to be assessed under the previous 5-year rule
PT.renewal_requirements: residence permit renewed every 2 years, contingent on maintaining the qualifying investment and minimum presence
PT.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Valid private health insurance; Verifiable source of funds
PT.key_benefits: Access to the Schengen Area for visa-free travel; One of the lowest physical presence requirements among EU programs; Non-habitual resident tax regime available separately for qualifying new tax residents
PT.taxation_notes: non-habitual resident (NHR) regime, where still available to new applicants, offers reduced tax rates on qualifying foreign-source income for a fixed number of years
PT.application_steps: choose investment route; obtain a Portuguese NIF and bank account; submit the AIMA application online; attend biometrics appointment; receive the residence permit and renew every 2 years
PT.dual_citizenship: Fully permitted — Portugal imposes no restriction on holding multiple nationalities and does not require renunciation of any prior citizenship

GR.investment_route: real estate purchase, with thresholds varying by region: 250000 EUR in lower-demand areas, 400000 EUR and 800000 EUR in higher-demand zones including central Athens, Thessaloniki, Mykonos, and Santorini
GR.investment_breakdown: combining multiple smaller properties to reach the threshold is permitted in most zones; commercial-to-residential conversion projects also qualify
GR.additional_fees: property transfer tax (~3%), notary and legal fees, and a residence permit administrative fee apply on top of the purchase price
GR.physical_presence_requirement: no minimum stay required to maintain the residence permit
GR.due_diligence: standard due diligence tied to the property purchase and source-of-funds verification
GR.family_inclusion: Spouse; Children under 21; Dependent parents of either spouse
GR.naturalization_timeline: eligible to apply for citizenship after 7 years of legal residence, subject to a Greek language and culture integration exam
GR.renewal_requirements: residence permit tied to continued ownership of the qualifying property; permit renewed every 5 years
GR.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds
GR.key_benefits: No minimum stay requirement makes it popular with investors who don't plan to relocate full time; The purchased property can be rented out for income while the permit remains valid
GR.taxation_notes: non-resident investors are generally taxed only on Greek-source income (including rental income from the qualifying property)
GR.application_steps: select a qualifying property; obtain a Greek tax number (AFM); sign the purchase contract before a notary; register the property; submit the residence permit application with proof of ownership
GR.dual_citizenship: Fully permitted — Greece allows dual and multiple citizenship

IT.investment_route: Innovative startup investment (250000 EUR); Investment in an Italian limited company (500000 EUR); Italian government bonds (2000000 EUR, held 2 years); Philanthropic donation (1000000 EUR)
IT.investment_breakdown: startup investments must go into companies registered on Italy's official innovative-startup register to qualify
IT.additional_fees: visa application fee, permit-of-stay fee, and legal/notary costs apply in addition to the core investment
IT.processing_time: 2-3 months for the nulla osta clearance, plus consular visa issuance time
IT.physical_presence_requirement: no minimum stay required to maintain the residence permit
IT.due_diligence: standard due diligence through the Investor Visa Committee
IT.naturalization_timeline: eligible to apply for citizenship after 10 years of legal residence in Italy (the standard naturalization period, not investment-specific)
IT.renewal_requirements: 2-year residence permit, renewable for a further 3 years subject to maintaining the investment
IT.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds
IT.key_benefits: Access to the Schengen Area; The government's flat-tax regime for new residents (regime forfettario) can substantially reduce tax on foreign-source income
IT.taxation_notes: eligible new residents may opt into a flat annual substitute tax on foreign-sourced income instead of ordinary progressive rates, for a period of up to 15 years
IT.application_steps: apply for nulla osta clearance online via the Investor Visa Committee portal; obtain the investor visa at an Italian consulate; enter Italy and complete the investment within 3 months; apply for the residence permit
IT.dual_citizenship: Fully permitted — Italy has allowed dual citizenship without requiring renunciation since its 1992 nationality law reform

MT.investment_route: Non-refundable government contribution (98000-108000 EUR depending on property route) plus property purchase (375000 EUR, or 300000 EUR in Gozo/South Malta) or 5-year property rental (14000 EUR/year, or 10000 EUR/year in Gozo/South Malta)
MT.investment_breakdown: an additional 2000 EUR donation to a registered Maltese NGO is required; property must be held or the lease maintained for a minimum of 5 years
MT.additional_fees: due diligence fees (~7500 EUR for the main applicant, ~5000 EUR for spouse, ~3000 EUR per additional dependant) apply on top of the government contribution
MT.physical_presence_requirement: no minimum stay required to maintain permanent residence status
MT.due_diligence: standard due diligence, considered one of the more rigorous EU programs given Malta's EU-membership stakes
MT.family_inclusion: Spouse; Children and grandchildren (dependent); Parents/grandparents of either spouse — family inclusion extends across up to 5 generations
MT.naturalization_timeline: MPRP does not itself lead to citizenship; a separate ordinary naturalization route requires years of demonstrated residence and is unrelated to this program
MT.renewal_requirements: property must remain held (or rented) for at least 5 years; after that period the holding requirement lapses but permanent residence status itself does not expire
MT.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds; Valid health insurance covering Malta
MT.key_benefits: EU-adjacent residency with Schengen travel rights; No minimum stay requirement; The 5-year property hold is shorter than several comparable EU programs
MT.taxation_notes: Malta's non-domicile tax regime taxes qualifying residents only on Malta-source income and remitted foreign income, not worldwide income
MT.application_steps: engage a licensed agent; submit application to Residency Malta Agency; pay the government contribution and secure the property; complete due diligence; residence card issued

CY.investment_route: Real estate purchase (300000 EUR plus VAT, new-build residential property from a licensed developer); Investment in a Cyprus-registered company's share capital; Units in a Cyprus collective investment fund
CY.investment_breakdown: the real estate route requires a first-time purchase (cannot be a resale) and the full amount must be paid from abroad
CY.additional_fees: VAT (reduced rate available on first residential purchase), legal fees, and property transfer costs apply on top of the purchase price
CY.physical_presence_requirement: must visit Cyprus at least once every 2 years to keep the permit valid; no minimum annual stay otherwise
CY.due_diligence: standard due diligence tied to source-of-funds and the property transaction
CY.family_inclusion: spouse and dependent children under 25 (in full-time education)
CY.naturalization_timeline: the CBI citizenship route linked to this scheme was suspended in 2020; permanent residence itself does not convert to citizenship automatically
CY.renewal_requirements: permit is permanent once granted, subject to the once-every-2-years visit requirement and proof of continued qualifying income
CY.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Proof of stable annual income from abroad (currently roughly 50000 EUR plus 15000 EUR per dependant)
CY.key_benefits: Fast processing relative to most EU programs; Minimal physical presence requirement; EU-adjacent lifestyle and Schengen-adjacent travel (Cyprus is not yet in Schengen)
CY.taxation_notes: Cyprus's non-domicile regime exempts qualifying residents from tax on foreign dividends and interest for 17 years
CY.application_steps: purchase a qualifying new-build property; submit the residence permit application with proof of income and property ownership; attend interview if required; permit issued
CY.dual_citizenship: Fully permitted — Cyprus allows dual and multiple citizenship (note: this specific Permanent Residence Permit does not itself grant citizenship)

HU.investment_route: Investment in a regulated Hungarian real estate fund (250000 EUR); Direct residential property purchase (500000 EUR); Donation to a Hungarian higher-education institution (1000000 EUR)
HU.investment_breakdown: the real estate fund route is the most accessible entry point and does not require direct property management
HU.additional_fees: government administrative fees and legal costs apply on top of the core investment
HU.physical_presence_requirement: no minimum stay required to maintain the residence permit
HU.due_diligence: standard due diligence through Hungary's National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing
HU.naturalization_timeline: the program does not itself lead to citizenship; a separate ordinary naturalization route applies based on years of residence
HU.renewal_requirements: residence permit issued for 10 years and is renewable, among the longest single-issue terms of any EU golden visa
HU.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds
HU.key_benefits: Access to the Schengen Area; A comparatively low entry threshold for a full EU residence permit; Relaunched in 2024 after Hungary's earlier bond-based program was discontinued in 2017
HU.taxation_notes: worldwide income taxed only if tax-resident in Hungary
HU.application_steps: choose the investment route; submit application to the National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing; complete due diligence; residence permit issued
HU.dual_citizenship: Fully permitted — Hungary allows dual and multiple citizenship (note: this residence program does not itself grant citizenship)

LV.investment_route: real estate purchase (250000 EUR minimum, one or more properties) plus a one-time state fee of approximately 5% of the property value
LV.investment_breakdown: alternative routes include subordinated deposits in a Latvian bank (280000 EUR) or investment in a Latvian company's share capital (50000 EUR plus 40000 EUR paid in state and municipal taxes over 3 years)
LV.additional_fees: notary, legal, and property registration fees apply on top of the purchase price and state fee
LV.physical_presence_requirement: no minimum stay required to maintain the residence permit
LV.due_diligence: standard due diligence through the Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs
LV.naturalization_timeline: the program does not itself lead to citizenship; a separate ordinary naturalization route applies based on years of residence and a Latvian language test
LV.renewal_requirements: residence permit valid for 5 years initially, renewable subject to continued property ownership
LV.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds
LV.key_benefits: Access to the Schengen Area; One of the lower property-investment thresholds among EU golden visa programs
LV.taxation_notes: worldwide income taxed only if tax-resident in Latvia
LV.application_steps: select a qualifying property; pay the purchase price and state fee; submit application to the Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs; residence permit issued
LV.dual_citizenship: Restricted — Latvia only permits dual citizenship with a specific list of countries (mainly EU/EEA/NATO/EFTA states and a small number of others); dual citizenship with most other countries requires special exemption (note: this residence program does not itself grant citizenship)

US.investment_route: Investment in a Targeted Employment Area (TEA — rural or high-unemployment area, 800000 USD) or standard investment elsewhere (1050000 USD); Investment must create or preserve at least 10 full-time US jobs for qualifying workers
US.investment_breakdown: most applicants invest through a USCIS-designated Regional Center, pooling capital into a project rather than directly running a business
US.additional_fees: USCIS filing fees for Form I-526E and Form I-829 (several thousand USD each), plus regional center administrative fees which vary by project
US.processing_time: 18-24 months for I-526E processing, plus additional time for visa/adjustment of status; total timeline can extend well beyond 2 years depending on backlog and country of origin
US.physical_presence_requirement: no minimum physical presence required to maintain conditional status, though standard green card rules on maintaining US residence apply once issued
US.due_diligence: extensive lawful-source-of-funds due diligence — considered among the strictest of any residency-by-investment program globally
US.naturalization_timeline: eligible to apply for US citizenship after 5 years as a lawful permanent resident, the same timeline as any other green card holder
US.renewal_requirements: conditional green card issued for 2 years; Form I-829 must be filed before expiry to remove conditions and receive a standard 10-year green card
US.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable lawful source of investment funds; Investment must create/preserve 10 qualifying US jobs
US.key_benefits: a direct path to a US green card and eventual citizenship with no employer sponsorship or job offer required, unlike most other US work-based visas
US.taxation_notes: US tax residents (including green card holders) are taxed on worldwide income once the green card is issued
US.application_steps: select a Regional Center project or direct investment; file Form I-526E petition with USCIS; obtain conditional green card via consular processing or adjustment of status; file Form I-829 after 2 years to remove conditions
US.dual_citizenship: Permitted in practice — the US naturalization oath contains renunciatory language but the US does not actively enforce it or require proof that another nationality was relinquished, so most naturalized US citizens retain their original citizenship if their home country also allows it

PA.investment_route: Real estate purchase (300000 USD); Securities investment through a licensed Panamanian brokerage (300000 USD, 5yr hold); Fixed-term bank deposit (750000 USD, 5yr hold)
PA.investment_breakdown: real estate route is the most commonly used and can include one or more properties combined to reach the threshold
PA.additional_fees: government and legal processing fees apply in addition to the qualifying investment
PA.physical_presence_requirement: no minimum stay required to maintain residency
PA.due_diligence: standard due diligence through Panama's National Immigration Service
PA.naturalization_timeline: eligible to apply for citizenship after 5 years of holding permanent residence, subject to a Spanish-language and civics test
PA.renewal_requirements: permanent residence is granted directly (not a renewable temporary status) provided the qualifying investment is maintained for its hold period
PA.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds
PA.key_benefits: One of the fastest routes to permanent (not temporary) residency of any program worldwide; Panama's territorial tax system means foreign-sourced income is not taxed
PA.taxation_notes: territorial tax system — only Panama-sourced income is taxed; foreign-sourced income, including from investments held abroad, is not taxed
PA.application_steps: select the investment route; submit application to the National Immigration Service with proof of investment; complete due diligence; permanent residence card issued
PA.dual_citizenship: Fully permitted — Panama allows dual and multiple citizenship

SG.investment_route: Business expansion investment in an existing Singapore-based business (10000000 SGD, minimum 3-year track record and revenue thresholds); Investment into a GIP-approved fund (10000000 SGD); Establishment of a new single family office (200000000 SGD assets under management)
SG.investment_breakdown: applicants must submit a detailed business or investment plan for evaluation by the Economic Development Board before any capital is committed
SG.additional_fees: no fixed government fee is published; costs are dominated by the qualifying investment itself and professional advisory fees
SG.processing_time: 6-12 months, including an in-person interview and business plan evaluation
SG.physical_presence_requirement: case-by-case, generally expected to demonstrate genuine commitment to Singapore over time
SG.due_diligence: extensive due diligence including business track record, net worth verification, and a formal interview; among the most selective residency-by-investment programs globally, with a high rejection rate
SG.naturalization_timeline: the GIP does not itself grant citizenship; separate naturalization is possible after an extended period of residence and is highly selective
SG.renewal_requirements: permanent residence is granted directly if approved, without an intermediate temporary-visa stage
SG.eligibility_criteria: A proven entrepreneurial or business track record; Substantial verifiable net worth well beyond the headline investment figure
SG.key_benefits: Access to Singapore's status as a leading Asia-Pacific financial and business hub; Permanent residency (not merely a long-stay visa) if approved
SG.taxation_notes: Singapore taxes residents only on Singapore-sourced income and on foreign income remitted into Singapore; foreign income kept offshore is generally not taxed
SG.application_steps: submit a business or investment proposal to the Economic Development Board; undergo evaluation and interview; receive approval in principle; complete the investment; permanent residence granted
SG.dual_citizenship: Not permitted — Singapore requires renunciation of all other citizenships upon naturalization (note: this program grants permanent residence, not citizenship, but Singapore's broader citizenship law is relevant for investors planning that far ahead)

BR.investment_route: Business investment (500000 BRL standard, reduced to 150000 BRL for approved technology, AI, or green-energy startups); Passive real estate purchase (1000000 BRL in urban centers, 700000 BRL in the North/Northeast)
BR.investment_breakdown: the reduced startup threshold applies only to companies registered with Brazil's approved innovation programs
BR.additional_fees: company registration and legal fees apply in addition to the core investment for the business route
BR.physical_presence_requirement: no minimum stay required to maintain the residence permit
BR.due_diligence: standard due diligence tied to the registered investment plan
BR.naturalization_timeline: eligible to apply for permanent residency after 4 years, and for citizenship after a further 4 years of permanent residence (8 years total)
BR.renewal_requirements: residence permit renewed periodically provided the investment is maintained
BR.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds; Registered investment plan filed with Brazilian authorities
BR.key_benefits: One of the lowest-cost investor residency routes among major economies; A Brazilian passport grants residency rights across the 9-country Mercosur bloc (Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Paraguay, Peru, Uruguay)
BR.taxation_notes: worldwide income taxed only if tax-resident in Brazil (183+ days per year)
BR.application_steps: register the investment plan with the relevant Brazilian agency; apply for the visa at a Brazilian consulate or convert status in-country; residence permit issued
BR.dual_citizenship: Fully permitted — Brazil allows dual and multiple citizenship

NZ.investment_route: Growth category (5000000 NZD into managed funds, direct investment, or bonds, with at least 50% in growth/higher-risk assets, minimum stay 21 days over 3 years); Balanced category (10000000 NZD, at least 25% in growth assets, minimum stay 105 days over 5 years)
NZ.investment_breakdown: acceptable growth assets include New Zealand equities, private equity, and venture capital; philanthropic donations can offset up to a portion of the required minimum stay
NZ.additional_fees: visa application fees and approved financial adviser costs apply in addition to the qualifying investment
NZ.processing_time: 4-6 months for visa approval, plus the investment period itself before permanent residence is granted
NZ.physical_presence_requirement: 21 days over 3 years (Growth category) or 105 days over 5 years (Balanced category)
NZ.due_diligence: standard due diligence plus verification of business/investment experience and English language ability
NZ.naturalization_timeline: leads to permanent residence at the end of the qualifying investment period, with citizenship available afterward through New Zealand's standard residence-based naturalization route
NZ.renewal_requirements: the resident visa converts to permanent residence once the investment period and presence requirements are met
NZ.eligibility_criteria: Proven business or investment experience; Verifiable source of funds; English language ability (or a fee to waive the requirement for dependants)
NZ.key_benefits: Relaunched in 2025 with lower thresholds and shorter minimum-stay requirements than the prior program; Strong rule of law, low corruption, and high quality of life
NZ.taxation_notes: worldwide income taxed if tax-resident in New Zealand; New Zealand does not levy a general capital gains tax on most personal investments
NZ.application_steps: submit an Expression of Interest; obtain approval in principle; make the qualifying investment within 12 months; visa granted; meet minimum stay requirement over the investment period
NZ.dual_citizenship: Fully permitted — New Zealand allows dual and multiple citizenship

PY.investment_route: Investment in an approved tourism-sector project (hospitality, eco-tourism, or related infrastructure)
PY.investment_breakdown: qualifying projects are pre-vetted and listed by Paraguay's Ministry of Industry and Commerce
PY.additional_fees: government processing fees apply in addition to the qualifying investment
PY.physical_presence_requirement: no minimum stay required to maintain residency
PY.due_diligence: standard due diligence through the Ministry of Industry and Commerce and immigration authorities
PY.naturalization_timeline: eligible to apply for citizenship after 3 years of permanent residence, one of the shortest naturalization timelines among residency-by-investment programs
PY.renewal_requirements: permanent residence is granted directly and does not require periodic renewal in the way temporary visas do
PY.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds
PY.key_benefits: One of the lowest entry thresholds and fastest South American residency-by-investment routes; Paraguay's territorial tax system means foreign-sourced income is untaxed
PY.taxation_notes: territorial tax system — only Paraguay-sourced income is taxed
PY.application_steps: select a qualifying tourism project; submit application to the Ministry of Industry and Commerce; complete due diligence; permanent residence granted
PY.dual_citizenship: Fully permitted — Paraguay allows dual and multiple citizenship

MC.investment_route: bank deposit of at least 500000 EUR with a Monaco-based bank, combined with securing accommodation in Monaco (purchase or lease) and demonstrating financial self-sufficiency
MC.investment_breakdown: the deposit is not a donation — funds remain the applicant's own assets and can typically be invested through the same bank once residency is secured
MC.additional_fees: bank account setup costs, accommodation costs (purchase or lease, which can be substantial given Monaco's property market), and application processing fees apply on top of the deposit
MC.physical_presence_requirement: must genuinely reside in Monaco; the residence card requires periodic renewal that depends on demonstrating actual presence
MC.due_diligence: standard due diligence through the Monaco government and the sponsoring bank
MC.family_inclusion: spouse and dependent children can apply for residence cards alongside the main applicant
MC.naturalization_timeline: eligible to apply for Monegasque naturalization after 10 years of residence, one of the longer timelines among wealth-based residency programs, and naturalization remains fully discretionary
MC.renewal_requirements: the initial residence card is valid for 1 year, then renewable for 3-year periods, contingent on continued residence and financial self-sufficiency
MC.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Demonstrated financial self-sufficiency; No employment income earned outside Monaco required (though many residents do work)
MC.key_benefits: Monaco levies no personal income tax on residents (French nationals are a historic exception under a bilateral treaty); Access to one of the world's most secure and prestigious residency addresses
MC.taxation_notes: no personal income tax for non-French residents; no capital gains tax on personal investments
MC.application_steps: open a qualifying account with a Monaco bank and deposit the required funds; secure accommodation; submit residence application with proof of funds and accommodation; attend interview; residence card issued
MC.dual_citizenship: Not applicable to this residence permit; Monegasque naturalization, when eventually pursued, generally requires renunciation of prior nationality

AD.investment_route: Investment in Andorran real estate, company shares, government debt; Financial instruments (400000 EUR), plus a mandatory 50000 EUR interest-free deposit with the Andorran Financial Authority (AFA), refunded when residence status ends
AD.investment_breakdown: the AFA deposit is separate from and additional to the 400000 EUR qualifying investment, and is returned in full if the applicant later relinquishes residency
AD.additional_fees: legal and notary fees for the property or investment purchase apply on top of the investment and deposit amounts
AD.physical_presence_requirement: minimum 90 days per year physical presence required to maintain the permit
AD.due_diligence: standard due diligence through the Andorran immigration department
AD.family_inclusion: spouse and dependent children can be included as dependants on the same application
AD.naturalization_timeline: citizenship is available after 20 years of residence, one of the longest naturalization timelines of any residency-by-investment program, and requires renunciation of the applicant's existing nationality since Andorra does not generally permit dual citizenship for naturalized citizens
AD.renewal_requirements: residence permit is renewable periodically provided the 90-day presence requirement and investment are maintained
AD.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable annual income of at least approximately 54900 EUR (rising with each dependant); Private health insurance
AD.key_benefits: Andorra's low-tax regime (income tax capped around 10%) combined with a high quality of life in the Pyrenees; The AFA deposit is fully refundable, unlike a donation-based program
AD.taxation_notes: personal income tax capped at approximately 10%; no wealth tax and no inheritance tax
AD.application_steps: select the qualifying investment; open the mandatory AFA deposit account; submit residence application with proof of income and health insurance; attend interview; permit issued
AD.dual_citizenship: Not applicable to this residence permit; Andorran naturalization, when eventually pursued after 20 years, generally requires renunciation of prior nationality since Andorra does not recognize dual citizenship for the naturalized

MY.investment_route: Fixed deposit in a Malaysian bank, tiered by program level: Silver (150000 USD), Gold (500000 USD), Platinum (1000000 USD), plus a mandatory property purchase at each tier (Silver 600000 MYR, Gold 1000000 MYR, Platinum 2000000 MYR); A lower-cost Special Economic Zone route exists at 65000 USD (under 50) or 32000 USD (50 and older)
MY.investment_breakdown: up to 50% of the fixed deposit can be withdrawn after the first year for an approved local property purchase, medical expenses, or education once conditions are met; the purchased property must be held for 10 years
MY.additional_fees: licensed operator/agent fees typically run 20000-50000 MYR on top of the deposit and property costs
MY.processing_time: several months, varying by tier and completeness of documentation
MY.physical_presence_requirement: minimum 60 days per year physical presence required to maintain most tiers
MY.due_diligence: standard due diligence including a Letter of Good Conduct from the applicant's home country
MY.family_inclusion: Spouse; Dependent children; — under specific conditions — dependent parents
MY.naturalization_timeline: MM2H is a residency pass only and does not itself lead to permanent residency or citizenship
MY.renewal_requirements: visa validity ranges from 5 years (Silver) to 20 years (Platinum), renewable subject to maintaining the fixed deposit and property conditions
MY.eligibility_criteria: Minimum age 21 (Silver/SEZ) or 25 (Gold/Platinum); Clean criminal record; Valid medical insurance (waived for applicants over 59)
MY.key_benefits: Foreign income and funds remitted under the program, plus interest earned on the required fixed deposit, are not taxed; Access to Malaysia's healthcare and international schools; Only the Platinum tier carries limited work rights
MY.taxation_notes: foreign-sourced income and remitted funds under MM2H are not taxed; interest on the fixed deposit itself is also tax-exempt
MY.application_steps: select a tier; open the fixed deposit account; complete the mandatory property purchase; submit application with financial and medical documents to MOTAC; visa issued
MY.dual_citizenship: Not applicable — MM2H is a residency pass only and does not lead to citizenship; Malaysia does not generally recognize dual citizenship for its own nationals

TH.program_name: Long-Term Resident (LTR) Visa — Wealthy Global Citizen category
TH.investment_route: Minimum 1000000 USD in global assets, including at least 500000 USD invested in Thai government bonds, foreign direct investment; Thai real estate; Alternative categories exist for remote workers and pensioners with lower financial thresholds
TH.investment_breakdown: the Wealthy Global Citizen category has no age requirement, unlike the Wealthy Pensioner category which requires applicants to be 50 or older with qualifying passive income
TH.additional_fees: government fee of 50000 THB (approximately 1400 USD) covers the full 10-year visa, not charged annually
TH.processing_time: typically 4-8 weeks after a complete application is submitted to the Board of Investment (BOI)
TH.physical_presence_requirement: no minimum annual stay required to maintain the visa, though annual reporting to immigration is mandatory
TH.due_diligence: standard due diligence through Thailand's Board of Investment in cooperation with the Immigration Bureau
TH.family_inclusion: spouse and dependent children can be included on the same application
TH.naturalization_timeline: the LTR visa does not lead to permanent residence or citizenship; it is a long-stay visa route only
TH.renewal_requirements: issued as a 10-year visa structured as two 5-year stamps; the second 5 years requires re-confirming eligibility, it is not automatic
TH.eligibility_criteria: Minimum health insurance coverage of 50000 USD; Or a minimum balance of 100000 USD in a savings account as alternative financial security
TH.key_benefits: One of the longest-duration Asia-Pacific residency visas without requiring permanent relocation; Includes streamlined digital work permit access and tax benefits for eligible categories; Annual reporting only, not the 90-day reporting required of other Thai visas
TH.taxation_notes: LTR visa holders under the Wealthy Global Citizen and other qualifying categories may access preferential personal income tax treatment on foreign-sourced income under Thai Revenue Department rules
TH.application_steps: confirm eligibility under one of the four LTR categories; submit application and documents to the BOI; upon endorsement, apply for the visa at a Thai embassy or in-country; collect the visa in person at the BOI's One Bangkok center
TH.dual_citizenship: Not applicable — the LTR visa does not lead to citizenship

ID.investment_route: Individual passive investment in Indonesian government bonds, shares; Mutual funds (350000 USD for a 5-year visa, 700000 USD for 10 years); Business/corporate investment establishing a company in Indonesia (2500000-25000000 USD depending on visa duration and structure)
ID.investment_breakdown: a lower-cost Second Home Visa (E33) also exists as a separate route, requiring only a 2 billion IDR (approximately 130000 USD) bank deposit or property purchase, though it grants fewer privileges than the full Golden Visa
ID.additional_fees: government processing fees and, for the business route, company registration costs apply on top of the qualifying investment
ID.processing_time: a few weeks once documents are complete; the application is submitted entirely online
ID.physical_presence_requirement: no physical presence requirement; the e-visa and re-entry permit are issued automatically upon arrival
ID.due_diligence: standard due diligence including a clean criminal and immigration record check
ID.family_inclusion: Spouse and dependent children under 18 are automatically eligible with no additional qualifying investment required; Though separate government fees apply per dependant
ID.naturalization_timeline: the Golden Visa does not itself lead to citizenship; a separate long-term residence permit (KITAP) can be pursued after extended legal residence
ID.renewal_requirements: issued for 5 or 10 years depending on the investment tier and renewable subject to maintaining the qualifying investment
ID.eligibility_criteria: 18+ (or applicable minimum for the category); Clean criminal and immigration record; Valid passport with 6+ months remaining validity; Proof of financial independence; Comprehensive health insurance
ID.key_benefits: No language, education, or employment requirements; Investors and family can live, invest, and conduct business in Indonesia without needing a separate work permit for passive investment activity
ID.taxation_notes: Indonesia taxes residents on worldwide income if tax-resident (183+ days per year); foreign income of non-tax-resident visa holders is generally not taxed
ID.application_steps: select the passive or business investment route; prepare the signed investment commitment letter and supporting documents; submit the application online through Indonesia's immigration system; receive the e-visa and re-entry permit on arrival
ID.dual_citizenship: Not applicable — the Golden Visa does not lead to citizenship; Indonesia does not generally recognize dual citizenship for adults

MU.investment_route: Investment in high-growth sectors as designated under the program (financial services, real estate, or other approved categories); Full sector-by-sector detail is being finalized as the program rolls out through 2026
MU.investment_breakdown: the program is explicitly positioned around capital preservation and tax efficiency rather than a single fixed real-estate threshold
MU.additional_fees: further detail on government or processing fees has not yet been published as of the program's rollout
MU.processing_time: as little as 5 working days for initial review, according to program materials
MU.physical_presence_requirement: requirement not yet fully published; details expected to align with Mauritius's existing residency-by-investment norms
MU.due_diligence: standard due diligence expected, consistent with Mauritius's existing investor and real estate residency schemes
MU.family_inclusion: family inclusion is expected but exact terms have not yet been published
MU.naturalization_timeline: the program is residency-focused; Mauritius's separate naturalization rules apply for any eventual citizenship route and are not tied to this program
MU.renewal_requirements: not yet fully published as the program rolls out through 2026
MU.key_benefits: positioned as a fast, tax-efficient entry point into Mauritius, an established residency-by-investment jurisdiction with a stable legal system based on both French civil and English common law traditions
MU.taxation_notes: Mauritius has no capital gains tax and no inheritance tax; its double-tax-treaty network is extensive, particularly with India and African markets
MU.application_steps: full application steps have not yet been published; interested applicants should confirm current procedure directly with the Economic Development Board of Mauritius
MU.status: active, launched 2026 (full program details still being published)
MU.dual_citizenship: Not yet published as the program rolls out through 2026

AE.investment_route: Deposit of at least AED 2,000,000 confirmed by a letter from an accredited investment fund; Valid commercial or industrial licence plus a Memorandum of Association showing company capital of at least AED 2,000,000; Letter from the Federal Tax Authority confirming the owner/partner pays at least AED 250,000 in taxes annually
AE.investment_breakdown: any one of the three routes independently qualifies — a fund deposit, a licensed company with sufficient capital, or a sufficiently high annual tax contribution
AE.additional_fees: Emirates ID issuance fees and standard visa processing fees apply in addition to the qualifying investment
AE.physical_presence_requirement: no minimum stay required to maintain the visa
AE.due_diligence: standard due diligence through the relevant emirate's ICP or GDRFA authority, including verification of the fund letter, company licence, or tax authority letter
AE.family_inclusion: Spouse; Children of any age (with conditions for adult children); Parents; Domestic staff/housekeepers of the primary holder
AE.naturalization_timeline: the UAE does not offer a standard path to citizenship through investment; naturalization is granted only in exceptional, discretionary cases unrelated to this visa
AE.renewal_requirements: issued for 10 years and renewable indefinitely provided the underlying investment or qualifying condition is maintained
AE.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds; One of the three public-investment routes must be documented
AE.key_benefits: 10-year renewable residency, the longest track under this category; No personal income tax; Holders can sponsor extended family and domestic staff
AE.taxation_notes: no personal income tax; no capital gains tax on personally held investment property
AE.application_steps: secure one of the three qualifying public-investment routes; obtain the supporting letter or licence documentation; apply via the relevant emirate's ICP or GDRFA smart portal; complete biometrics and a medical test; Emirates ID and visa issued
AE.dual_citizenship: Not applicable — this visa does not lead to UAE citizenship

AE.investment_route: Ownership of one or more properties in the UAE valued at AED 2,000,000 or more, held without any outstanding loan against them
AE.investment_breakdown: off-plan property from approved developers is generally accepted; multiple properties can be combined to reach the AED 2,000,000 threshold
AE.additional_fees: Dubai Land Department or equivalent emirate property registration fees, plus Emirates ID issuance fees, apply in addition to the property price
AE.physical_presence_requirement: no minimum stay required to maintain the visa
AE.due_diligence: verification of a letter from the Land Registration Department confirming unencumbered ownership, plus standard ICP/GDRFA due diligence
AE.family_inclusion: Spouse; Children of any age (with conditions for adult children); Parents; Domestic staff/housekeepers of the primary holder
AE.naturalization_timeline: the UAE does not offer a standard path to citizenship through investment; naturalization is granted only in exceptional, discretionary cases unrelated to this visa
AE.renewal_requirements: issued for 5 years and renewable provided the qualifying property is still held, unencumbered, at renewal
AE.eligibility_criteria: 18+; Clean criminal record; Verifiable source of funds; Letter from the Land Registration Department confirming property ownership; Proof of residence in the UAE (property ownership or tenancy contract)
AE.key_benefits: Direct route to residency through property ownership alone, with no separate business or fund structure required; No personal income tax; Holders can sponsor extended family and domestic staff
AE.taxation_notes: no personal income tax; no capital gains tax on personally held investment property
AE.application_steps: purchase qualifying unencumbered property valued at AED 2,000,000+; obtain the ownership confirmation letter from the Land Registration Department; apply via the relevant emirate's ICP or GDRFA smart portal; complete biometrics and a medical test; Emirates ID and visa issued
AE.dual_citizenship: Not applicable — this visa does not lead to UAE citizenship
